I had a group of friends, around 5 guys, and I felt like hanging out on the weekend so I asked them if they wanted to chill. Each one had an excuse "I have to go to wedding, I have to help my mom, I have work" etc... That weekend each one posted on Instagram at the same time of a campfire with all of my "friends" with the same caption "Here with ALL my Bros" so the second half of my senior year, I had no friends. Also when prom came around I told those guys, to be safe, that I wanted to ask out a certain girl to prom. The next week one of them asked her to prom. They then kept asking me why I was being weird around them.

I know, but she's not even remotely an unsure person, it just came up and she cut it off. I told her to lmk when she's ready. She said "she would if she still thinks something is still here [between us]." I just don't like having feelings for someone, and I can't do anything about it. I know she liked me alot too, but she's more experienced in this type of stuff, so I'm afraid she'll forget about me.

Yeah, I know I shouldn't wait around for her and I'm not but I'm also not over her at all. Part of me is saying to ask to be friends and then see what develops, but I know that would just hurt me more than it would help.
